entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 09, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Preact

Contents / Boilerplates

  • Extension.js Templates (⭐12) - Preact starters for popup, new tab, content script and devtools pages, ready to run in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

Contents / Components

  • @zikojs/preact-console (⭐22) - A console-like UI component for Preact that renders JavaScript console output directly inside your application.

2. Awesome Graphql

iOS / React

  • Baton (⭐13) - Relay-style GraphQL client for SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, with a fragment beside each view and a normalized store the UI observes.

3. Awesome Langchain

Tools / Templates

  • Full-Stack AI Agent Template (⭐1.9k): FastAPI + Next.js project generator where the agent backend can be LangChain, LangGraph or DeepAgents (or Pydantic AI), with WebSocket streaming, RAG, auth and Docker setup

4. Awesome Lit

Similar libraries / Other Tools

  • pion (⭐82) - React Hooks API for web components using lit-html.

5. Awesome Storybook

Community resources

  • Sherlo - Visual regression testing for React Native, integrated with Storybook; renders on iOS and Android simulators in the cloud.

Examples

  • Bestax - Storybook

6. Awesome Datascience

Deep Learning Packages / Visualization Tools

  • cvdmaps - Colorblind-safe colormaps and color cycles for matplotlib. matplotlib's default cycle is not colorblind-safe; one call swaps it for an Okabe-Ito palette verified under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.

Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated)

  • Tour Group Headset and Loudspeaker Rules - 198 written rules from 36 countries on how guided tour groups may be heard at museums, palaces, archaeological sites and historic city centres (headset requirements, loudspeaker bans), each checked against its official source. CSV and JSONL, CC-BY-4.0.

7. Static Analysis

Multiple languages / Other

  • Kin — A graph-native code repository for people and AI agents. Kin parses supported languages into code entities and their relationships (calls, references, imports, inheritance) and versions them with the source. The kin CLI and an MCP server query the same graph for callers, references, traces and what a change might affect. Imports existing Git history. Public beta.

Other / Other

  • ember-template-lint (⭐265) — Linter for Ember or Handlebars templates.

8. Webcomponents the Right Way

Component Libraries

  • Accesserty UI Kit (⭐2) - HTML-first accessible web components with built-in keyboard behavior, state handling, and i18n. No runtime dependencies.

9. Magictools

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 AnimGen Free Sprite Sheet Tools - Browser tools that convert GIFs to sprite sheets and back, slice grid sheets or auto-extract sprites from sheets with no grid, export PNG sequences, and remove solid or green-screen GIF backgrounds. Files stay on your device; sheets come with Aseprite-format JSON.

10. Awesome Game Remakes

Action

  • Earthworm Jim HD Recompiled (⭐44) - Recomp of Earthworm Jim HD (Xbox 360) to PC.
  • King Kong Recompiled (⭐105) - Recomp of King Kong (Xbox 360) to PC.
  • MDK Sdl (⭐25) - Port of MDK (Shiny) to SDL. Includes enhancements.
  • Simpsons Wrestling Recompiled (⭐17) - Recomp of Simpsons Wrestling (PS1) to PC.
  • Starfox Recomp (⭐19) - Recomp + enhancement of Starfox (SNES).
  • Ultimate MK3 iOS (⭐26) - Recomp of Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 iOS to PC.

Adventure

  • Titanic: Adventure Out of Time (⭐9) - Recomp of Titanic Adventure Out of Time to Godot.

RPG

  • DQ8 Recompiled (⭐37) - Recomp of Dragon's Quest 8 (PS2) to PC.
  • Earthbound Companion (⭐10) - Recomp of Earthbound (SNES) to PC.
  • Ultima 5 (⭐8) - Modern engine for Ultima 5.

Platformer

  • Conker's Bad Fur Day Reloaded (⭐60) - Recomp and enhancements for Conker's Bad Fur Day (N64).

Racing

  • Daytona Arcade Recomp (⭐139) - Recomp of Daytona Racing to PC.
  • Rollcage Redux - Port of the classic game Rollcage.
  • RVGL - Cross-platform engine for Re-Volt.
  • SpeedBreaker (⭐125) - Recomp of Need For Speed: Most Wanted (2005, Xbox 360) to PC.

Simulator

  • OpenReliant (⭐18) - Rebuild of Starlancer in Zig and SDL3.

11. Awesome Cytodata

🌟 Purpose

  • Centralize Knowledge: Provide a "one-stop shop" for foundational and state-of-the-art research.
  • Lower Entry Barriers: Help new researchers navigate "Influential Papers" selected by the community.
  • Promote Open Science: Highlight publicly available datasets and open-source pipelines.
  • Standardize Discovery: Offer a professional, searchable index for DOIs and software repositories.

🚀 Key Features / 📚 The Literature Corpus

  • Advanced Search: Real-time fuzzy searching via Fuse.js across titles, authors, journals, and abstracts.
  • Author Formatting: Scientific citation style (Lastname, F. et al.) for professional scanning.
  • Filtering: Sort by year, category (Methods, Biology, Reviews, etc.), or influential status.
  • Direct Access: One-click DOI links to publisher pages.

🚀 Key Features / 💾 Dataset Index

  • A curated table of massive public releases like the Cell Painting Gallery, JUMP-CP, and RxRx.
  • Filterable by description and reference paper.

🚀 Key Features / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Catalog of community-standard tools including CellProfiler, DeepProfiler, and PyCytominer.
  • Categorized by purpose (Feature Extraction, Data Engineering, etc.).

🛠️ Technical Architecture / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Frontend: React 19+ (ESM-based via CDN for zero-install development).
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS for a clean, academic aesthetic.
  • Search Engine: Fuse.js for client-side fuzzy indexing of JSON data.
  • Data Layer: Flat JSON files in /data/ acting as a "Local Database" for easy community contributions.
  • Deployment: Automated GitHub Actions workflow for validation and hosting.

🤝 Contributing / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Read the CONTRIBUTING.md guide.
  • Run python3 scripts/add_resource.py paper or python3 scripts/add_resource.py dataset to add your entry (or edit the JSON files in public/data/ by hand).
  • Open a Pull Request.

12. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • NotWorking (⭐1) - Downdetector for AI agents: a skill and remote MCP server that checks whether other agents report the same site, skill or MCP server failure, and takes failure reports. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking.

MCP Servers

  • Datacircle - Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http datacircle https://api.datacircle.dev/mcp.

13. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Network Data Labs - An IP geolocation API with accuracy radius and confidence level, ASN, and Tor, known VPN, privacy relay and hosting signals. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per day.

Email

  • disban.io - Protect user signups from disposable emails, or just validate an email against disposable service. Free 2000 check credits per month, No Credit Card required.

Remote Desktop Tools

  • StarDesk - Free remote desktop for work and gaming with 4K HDR/144fps streaming across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.

14. Awesome Mac

Design and Product / Design Tools

  • Redlamp - Native, open-source raw photo editor that keeps Lightroom Classic's Develop workflow.

15. Awesome Rust

Applications / Image processing

  • storytold/vectorcraft (⭐3.8k) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator, built in pure Rust.

Applications / Productivity

  • burakdede/aisw (⭐124) [aisw] - Switch Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts with named profiles, cross-tool contexts and per-repository account guards

Applications / Video

  • storytold/effectcraft (⭐2.8k) - An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects, built in pure Rust.

Libraries / Data processing

  • faucet-hq/faucet-stream (⭐16) [faucet-core] - ETL that governs your data while it moves: a config-driven data-movement platform with pluggable source and sink connectors, CDC, in-flight masking and quality checks, run from YAML by a single binary or embedded as a library

16. Awesome Go

Artificial Intelligence

  • clai (⭐146) - Agentic harness focused on terminal workflows, following UNIX principles. No external dependencies, ideal for scripting/prototyping agentic apps, engine is also exposed as a package.

Job Scheduler

  • RunWisp (⭐64) - Single-binary replacement for cron and supervisord that keeps the exit code and output of every run, with a web UI and a TUI.

17. Awesome Ai

AI Coding Agents / General Purpose

  • Berrry-Computer/vibe-compiler (⭐70) — RAG for integrating GenAI in apps ☆70
  • Berrry-Computer/poorcoder (⭐60) — DIY Poor Man's AI Coder ☆60

entry.content:
1. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Boardgame

  • Parlour (⭐4) - Deterministic TypeScript card-game engine with a cozy browser table for Blitz and Wild.

2. Awesome Cakephp

Plugins / Authentication and Authorization

  • CakePasskeys plugin (⭐1) - Passkey (WebAuthn) registration and sign-in, with a JavaScript client and cells for managing passkeys.

Plugins / Debugging

  • OrcaServices/Heartbeat plugin (⭐4) - A plugin providing an application heartbeat status page with configurable sensors.

Plugins / Monitoring

  • Crustum/Rhythm plugin (⭐0) - Real-time application performance monitoring for CakePHP 5.x with metrics for HTTP requests, DB queries, queue, exceptions, and cache plus a live dashboard.

Plugins / REST and API

  • SwaggerUi plugin (⭐1) - A plugin for publishing Swagger UIs based on OpenAPI specification files.

Plugins / Search

  • Crustum/Explorator plugin (⭐0) - Driver-based full-text search for CakePHP Tables and Entities (collection, database, Algolia, Meilisearch, Typesense).

Plugins / Testing

  • DataValidationTesting plugin (⭐0) - A plugin to help testing data validation.

Plugins / Third Party APIs

  • Crustum/Saloon plugin (⭐0) - Integrates Saloon for building elegant HTTP API clients and SDKs, with CakePHP events, Bake generators, testing helpers, and cache/rate-limit bridges.

3. Awesome Developer First

Databases & Spreadsheets

  • Prisma Postgres - Managed Postgres with a free plan (1.01 GB, 200k operations/month, 50 databases) and paid plans from $10/month.

4. Awesome Mysql

Incubating

  • masume (⭐103) - Keyboard-first terminal database client with AI chat and an MCP server.

5. Awesome Mqtt

Tools

  • Spitfire - Self-hosted distributed load testing platform with a web UI; simulates thousands of MQTT devices (QoS 0/1/2 publish, subscribe, request-reply) alongside HTTP, Kafka and other protocols. Commercial, with a free edition.

Rust

  • AimDB (⭐101) - Typed, versioned data contracts over MQTT from no_std microcontrollers (Embassy) to the cloud (Tokio), with schema migrations at the hub.

6. Awesome Falsehood

Business

  • Things Many People Find Too Obvious To Have Told You Already - Reads like a list of falsehoods about the tech business: “There is no hidden reserve of smart people who know what they're doing, anywhere. Not in government, not in science, not in tech, (…) nowhere.”

7. Awesome Composer

Plugins / IRC

  • WP Org Closed Plugin (⭐6) - Marks packages as abandoned if closed on WordPress.org.

Tools / IRC

  • Composer Audit to SARIF Action (⭐1) - Convert Composer audit reports to SARIF files on GitHub Actions.

Packagist-compatible repositories / IRC

  • WordPress Packages - Composer repository for WordPress.org plugins and themes.
  • WP Sec Adv (⭐27) - Composer repository for WordPress security advisories.

8. Awesome Crystal

Scheduling

  • cronaute (⭐2) - Cron daemon for containers, shipped as a single static binary with a read-only dashboard

9. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • ai-wright (⭐1) - Open-source library that adds AI action, assertion, and data extraction steps to Playwright tests, using annotated screenshots and your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key.
  • assay (⭐102) - Deterministic command-line QA tool that serves a local web page, drives every control it finds in Chromium through Playwright. No tests to write and no LLM, with a Python API, an HTML report, and a plugin for AI coding agent. MIT, Python.

Software / Test Data Management

  • mailsocket - Inbox API that waits for an email OTP or magic link and returns it as JSON, with Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • RateMyApp Testing Brief Builder - Free, no-account tool for writing mobile usability-testing tasks, expected outcomes, and feedback instructions.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • Locust Kubernetes Operator (⭐93) - Run distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes with a LocustTest CRD.

Software / Screen Recording & Session Replays

  • Everframe - In-app bug reporter for mobile, web and TV apps that attaches an annotated screenshot, console, network, device info and an optional replay of the moments before the bug.

10. Awesome Rails

Gems / Other external resources

  • solid_objects (⭐40) - A gem for SQL-backed virtual actors: durable state, ordered calls, and reminders in the app's SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL database (pre-1.0). 🔴

11. Awesome Zig

Language Essentials / Data Structure and Algorithm

  • guanchzhou/zig-planar (⭐0) - Planarity testing with embeddings, Kuratowski certificates, and 4- and 5-coloring of planar graphs. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Large Language Model

  • guanchzhou/zig-select (⭐0) - Budgeted selection of retrieved chunks for LLM context: knapsack packing, score calibration, and diversity. AI-assisted.
  • guanchzhou/zig-diffuse (⭐0) - Re-ranking of retrieval scores by diffusion on link and nearest-neighbor graphs. AI-assisted.
  • guanchzhou/zig-lsh (⭐0) - Cross-polytope and hyperplane LSH with multi-probe for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted.
  • guanchzhou/zig-rabitq (⭐0) - RaBitQ one- to eight-bit vector codes with error bounds for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted.
  • guanchzhou/zig-pq (⭐0) - Product quantization, k-means, and IVF-PQ for approximate nearest-neighbor search. AI-assisted.

12. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Data Manipulation

  • polynx (⭐3) - Pandas-style query, eval, assign and group-by on string expressions, compiled to native Polars expressions with @var substitution, UDFs and LazyFrame support by @LowellWinston.

13. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • bashate (⭐399) — Code style enforcement for bash programs. The output format aims to follow pycodestyle (pep8) default output format.

14. Magictools

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

FPS

RPG

Python / Computer Vision

Terminal Apps / Databases

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 07, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Chrome Devtools

Tracing & Profiling

  • trace.cafe - Share and view web performance traces directly in the DevTools Performance panel (source (⭐142)).
  • speedscope (⭐6.8k) - Fast, interactive flamegraph viewer that imports Chrome .cpuprofile and timeline traces.
  • cpupro (⭐788) - Deep V8/Chrome .cpuprofile analyzer with flamegraphs, call trees, and hot-spot diagnostics.
  • Perfetto (⭐6.6k) - System profiling and trace analysis suite (ui.perfetto.dev) with Chromium trace support and SQL trace querying.

Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries

  • Puppeteer (⭐96k) - High-level Node.js API for controlling Chrome over CDP and WebDriver BiDi. See also awesome-puppeteer (⭐2.6k).

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

  • Rust: chromiumoxide (⭐1.4k) - Async/tokio library with generated types
  • Rust: Rust Headless Chrome (⭐3k) - High-level headless Chrome client
  • Python: Zendriver (⭐1.5k) - Async CDP browser automation
  • Ruby: Ferrum (⭐2.1k) - High-level API to control Chrome
  • Ruby: Cuprite (⭐1.4k) - Capybara driver
  • Kotlin: kdriver (⭐108) - High-level coroutine-based automation

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Agentic Browser Automation

  • chrome-devtools-mcp (⭐53k) - Official MCP server for Chrome DevTools, which also includes a CLI (⭐53k).
  • Webcmd (⭐2.6k) - Compiles site navigation into deterministic per-site CLI commands for AI agents.
  • bdg (⭐152) - Persistent background CDP session exposing DOM, network, console, and raw protocol methods as shell commands.

Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

  • ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend (⭐4.1k) - Canonical source repo for the Chrome DevTools UI (published to npm as chrome-devtools-frontend).
  • Chii (⭐2.2k) & Eruda (⭐21k) - Remote debugging server using the real devtools-frontend UI (Chii, a modern Weinre replacement) and in-page mobile DevTools console (Eruda).
  • vscode-js-debug (⭐2k) - Official DAP-compliant JavaScript and Chrome CDP debugger powering VS Code.

DevTools Extensions / Browser Adapters

  • Vue.js Developer Tools (⭐2.9k) - Inspect Vue.js components, state, and routing.

Alumni / Browser Adapters

  • noice-json-rpc (⭐46) - Proxy-based TypeScript/JS library exposing CDP domains directly as an API.

2. Awesome Ada

Open source / GPL (with linking exception)

  • SafeStreets - Free address-level walkability and pedestrian-safety analysis, scoring any neighborhood on a 15-minute-city framework using OpenStreetMap data.

Maps / Generators

  • MapPoster Online - Web-based map poster generator with customizable styles. (Source Code (⭐950))

Libraries / C/C++

  • Valhalla (⭐6.3k) - Routing engine written in C++. (Wiki)

Public APIs / Java

  • MapAtlas - REST API for geocoding, routing, isochrone, matrix, map matching, and MVT vector tiles built on OpenStreetMap data. (Docs)

2. Awesome D

Build Tools / Status page

  • rules_d (⭐27) - Bazel rules and toolchains for building D libraries, binaries, tests, protocol buffers, and projects that depend on DUB packages.
  • gazelle_d (⭐0) - Gazelle extension for generating Bazel build files from D sources and DUB manifests.

3. Awesome Jupyter

Rendering/Publishing/Conversion

  • ipynbtopdf - Browser-only Jupyter notebook to PDF converter; no upload or LaTeX toolchain.

4. Awesome Ruby

Spreadsheets and Documents

  • SimpleXlsxReader (⭐190) - A fast xlsx reader that parses cell values into plain Ruby primitives and dates/times.

5. Awesome Tmux

Tools and session management

  • pmux Drop-in tmux wrapper that lets you reach your sessions from the Pocketmux iOS/Android app (paid) over an end-to-end encrypted, peer-to-peer connection

6. Awesome Rest

Documentation / Symfony2

  • Sourcey - Static documentation generator from OpenAPI, MCP, Doxygen, godoc, rustdoc, and Markdown sources.

7. Awesome Api Clients

CLI

  • resto (⭐286) - Send pretty HTTP & API requests with TUI

8. Public Apis

Science & Math

  • API: Oliver's mTOR Atlas

    Description: Curated mTOR research: studies by evidence type, pathway claims, open questions

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

9. Awesome Cl

Mobile

  • Evergreen-Compose (⭐2) - Build native Android apps in Evergreen Common Lisp, using Jetpack Compose and Material 3. GPL-3.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exception-2.0.
    • Evergreen Compose supplies a shared, precompiled Android runtime. Application builds require EGCL and egcl-target-android (runtime API 4), no JDK, Kotlin compiler, Gradle, Android SDK or NDK.
    • Develop inside the running app. Connect Emacs with SLY or icl to the phone's Lisp image through an ADB-forwarded Slynk port. Evaluate Lisp, inspect application state, and update the running UI without rebuilding or reinstalling the APK

Work in progress

  • (LLM) Evergreen (⭐21): Evergreen is Common Lisp with a HotSpot-inspired native runtime, built from scratch in Rust. It starts executing in bytecode, compiles hot code to native instructions, and specializes dynamically typed programs as they run.
    • new as of Oct, 2026
    • warning: this is an experiment. The parts that do work may not behave the way you expect, or the way the standard says they should. It may never work.
    • Lightweight fibers with synchronous socket I/O
    • Native interoperability (C, JVM, Python)
    • Standalone applications and saved images.
    • The default x86-64 Linux build is fully static
    • Tree shaking of Lisp and Rust
    • Native Android applications with Slime-style development: see evergreen-compose (⭐2)
    • Core code, test suites, and documentation were almost entirely generated by AI assistants following high-level human prompts and specification. Conceptual architecture, prompt direction, and repository orchestration (minimal manual code review or line-by-line verification).

10. Awesome Neovim

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • 2giosangmitom/nightfall.nvim (⭐49) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] Dracula-inspired colorscheme with four flavors including a light variant.

11. Collective Ai Tools

Fashion

  • RealFun Color - Provides selfie-based personal color analysis and checks clothing colors against a personal color profile. #freemium

12. Awesome Zig

Fundamentals / Utility

  • hgrsd/duplik - Zig-based CLI to detect duplicate files. No-AI.

Language Essentials / Command Line and Argument Parser

  • hgrsd/zopt - Low-ceremony schemaless command line argument parser for the Zig ecosystem. No-AI.

13. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Validation

  • dataprof (⭐21) - Data profiling and quality gates for Polars and pandas DataFrames, CSV, JSON and Parquet, written in Rust, by @AndreaBozzo.

14. Awesome Dataviz

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
  • Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
  • chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
  • ChartGPU (⭐3.2k) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
  • DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
  • ECharts GL (⭐2.7k) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
  • Flot (⭐5.9k) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
  • heatmap.js (⭐6.4k) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
  • VChart (⭐1.8k) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
  • force-graph (⭐2.1k) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
  • Viz.js (⭐4.3k) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • chartjs-chart-financial (⭐809) - Chart.js module that adds candlestick and OHLC chart types.
  • HQChart (⭐3.4k) - K-line and stock charts with a technical indicator scripting engine, for web pages and WeChat mini programs.
  • KLineChart (⭐4.2k) - Lightweight, highly customizable candlestick (k-line) chart with zero dependencies and mobile support.
  • React Financial Charts (⭐1.4k) - React components for financial charts: candlesticks, technical indicators, overlays and drawing tools.
  • TradeCanvas (⭐22) - Financial charts with indicators, drawing tools and live feeds, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL.
  • Vela (⭐992) - Financial charting library with a headless core, native WebGL2 renderer and plugin SDK, from LuxAlgo.

JavaScript tools / Maps

  • COBE (⭐5.9k) - Lightweight WebGL globe library of about 5 kB, with configurable markers.
  • mapcn (⭐12k) - Map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and compatible with shadcn/ui.
  • TerriaJS (⭐1.4k) - Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers with catalogs of map layers.

JavaScript tools / React

  • Ant Design Charts (⭐2.2k) - React chart library based on AntV, with statistical charts, graphs and maps.
  • react-force-graph (⭐3.3k) - React components for 2D, 3D, VR and AR force-directed graphs.
  • react-plotly.js (⭐1.1k) - React component for Plotly.js charts, maintained by Plotly.

JavaScript tools / React Native

  • react-native-charts-wrapper (⭐2.5k) - React Native wrapper for MPAndroidChart and DGCharts on Android and iOS.
  • react-native-gifted-charts (⭐1.4k) - Bar, line, area, pie, radar, bubble and candlestick charts for React Native, with animations.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • asciichart (⭐2.1k) - ASCII line charts for the console in Node.js and browsers, with ports to other languages.
  • Flint (⭐4.3k) - Chart specification language from Microsoft that compiles to Vega-Lite, ECharts, Chart.js or Plotly.
  • LayerChart (⭐1.3k) - Composable Svelte chart components for cartesian, radial, hierarchical, graph and geo charts.
  • ng2-charts (⭐2.4k) - Angular directives for Chart.js charts.
  • vis-timeline (⭐2.6k) - Interactive timelines and 2D graphs with items and ranges, from the vis.js project.
  • Vue Data UI (⭐2.5k) - Vue 3 component library of charts, gauges, tables and other data visualizations.

C++ tools / Misc

  • ImPlot3D (⭐1.3k) - Immediate-mode 3D plotting extension for Dear ImGui, inspired by ImPlot.
  • OpenSpace (⭐1.3k) - Interactive software for visualizing the known universe, from astronomy catalogs to space missions.
  • Serial Studio (⭐7.2k) - Real-time telemetry dashboard for data from serial ports, Bluetooth LE, network sockets and other sources.

Dashboards and BI / Misc

  • datart (⭐2.3k) - Data visualization platform for building reports, dashboards and data stories.

Julia tools / Misc

  • AlgebraOfGraphics.jl (⭐519) - Algebraic grammar-of-graphics visualization for Julia, built on Makie.

Machine Learning tools / Misc

  • Model Explorer (⭐1.6k) - Hierarchical graph visualizer and debugger for ML models, from Google.
  • NN-SVG (⭐5.7k) - Web tool for drawing publication-ready neural network architecture diagrams and exporting them to SVG.
  • VisualDL (⭐4.9k) - Deep learning visualization toolkit for metrics, graphs, embeddings and more, from PaddlePaddle.

.NET tools / Misc

  • Plotly.NET (⭐862) - Interactive charts for F# and C#, based on Plotly.js.
  • XCharts (⭐3.8k) - Charting and data visualization library for Unity, built on UGUI.

Python tools / Misc

  • fastplotlib (⭐1.5k) - GPU-accelerated plotting library built on WGPU and pygfx for fast interactive visualization.
  • hvPlot (⭐1.4k) - High-level plotting API for pandas, xarray, Dask, NetworkX and other data structures, built on HoloViews.
  • ipyleaflet (⭐1.5k) - Interactive Leaflet maps in Jupyter notebooks, built on ipywidgets.
  • LIDA (⭐3.3k) - Generates visualizations and infographics from data with large language models, from Microsoft.
  • lightweight-charts-python (⭐2.2k) - Python interface to TradingView's Lightweight Charts for financial charts.
  • Lonboard (⭐962) - Fast, interactive geospatial data visualization in Jupyter, built on deck.gl and GeoArrow.
  • mpld3 (⭐2.4k) - Renders matplotlib figures as interactive D3.js graphics in the browser.
  • prettymaps (⭐14k) - Draws stylized maps from OpenStreetMap data, using osmnx and matplotlib.
  • pygal (⭐2.8k) - SVG charting library for Python with many chart types and interactive output.
  • PyGMT (⭐875) - Python interface to the Generic Mapping Tools (GMT) for maps and figures in the geosciences.
  • scattertext (⭐2.3k) - Interactive scatterplot visualizations of how language differs between groups of documents.
  • Sweetviz (⭐3.1k) - Generates self-contained HTML reports that visualize and compare datasets for exploratory analysis.
  • termgraph (⭐3.3k) - Draws bar charts, histograms and other basic graphs in the terminal, as a CLI or Python library.
  • viser (⭐2.8k) - Web-based 3D visualization library for computer vision and robotics, with GUI building blocks.
  • Vizro (⭐3.8k) - Low-code toolkit from McKinsey for building data visualization apps and dashboards, built on Dash.

R tools / Misc

  • circlize (⭐1k) - Circular visualization in R, such as chord diagrams and Circos-style genomic plots.
  • ggiraph (⭐880) - Makes ggplot2 graphics interactive, with tooltips, hover effects and selections.
  • ggpubr (⭐1.3k) - ggplot2-based functions for publication-ready plots with statistical annotations.
  • htmlwidgets (⭐801) - Framework for binding JavaScript visualization libraries to R, for use in R Markdown and Shiny.
  • tmap (⭐909) - Thematic maps in R, with a ggplot2-like layered syntax and static or interactive output.

Markup-based tools / Misc

  • C4-PlantUML (⭐7.4k) - PlantUML macros and styles for drawing software architecture diagrams with the C4 model.
  • CeTZ (⭐1.9k) - Drawing library for Typst with a TikZ-inspired API, for diagrams and plots.
  • Flowchart Fun (⭐3.4k) - Web app that generates flowcharts and diagrams from indented text.
  • nomnoml (⭐2.8k) - Draws UML diagrams from a simple text syntax.
  • PGF/TikZ (⭐1.4k) - TeX packages for programmatically drawing vector graphics and diagrams in LaTeX.
  • Svgbob (⭐4.2k) - Converts ASCII art diagrams into SVG.

Other tools / Misc

  • GeoLibre (⭐7.8k) - Cloud-native GIS app for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data on the web, desktop and mobile.
  • GMT (⭐983) - Command-line tools for processing geographic data and making publication-quality maps and plots.
  • mcp-server-chart (⭐4.4k) - MCP server from AntV that lets AI agents generate more than 25 chart types.
  • SankeyMATIC (⭐1.4k) - Web tool for building Sankey diagrams from a plain-text description of flows.
  • sqliteviz (⭐2.4k) - Browser app that loads CSV, JSON or SQLite files, runs SQL and charts the results offline.
  • ttyplot (⭐1.4k) - Real-time terminal plotting utility that reads data from standard input.
  • uMap (⭐1.6k) - Web app for creating maps with OpenStreetMap layers and embedding them in websites.

15. Webcomponents the Right Way

Component Libraries

  • Marvelous UI (⭐1) - Framework-agnostic custom elements and CSS components with design tokens and no runtime dependencies.

16. Awesome Game Remakes

Adventure

  • Flipendo (⭐0) - Source port of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone and Chamber of Secrets (PC, KnowWonder) on SurrealEngine. Requires the original game files.

17. Awesome Gemini Cli

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Awakado - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.

API Bridges & Proxies

  • cliproxy-rs (⭐16) - Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

MCP Servers

  • LinkMCP - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp.

18. Free for Dev

PaaS

  • velixir - EU-hosted PaaS that builds web apps from source in any language (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, Elixir, Rust, .NET and more), no Dockerfile needed. The free tier includes one app (0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM) that sleeps when idle, custom domains with TLS, and no credit card.

19. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Ebooks

  • Rapid Reader (⭐1) - Open-source RSVP speed reader for EPUB, PDF, and web articles with a full-text view.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • WhisperDrop 2 (⭐0) - Open-source local transcription for audio, video, YouTube, and meetings, with dictation into any app.

Utilities / Productivity

  • OpenNaga (⭐2) - Open-source Razer Synapse alternative for the Naga V2 HyperSpeed that remaps the side buttons and sets DPI and polling rate.

20. Awesome Rust

Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

  • cmccomb/rust-automl (⭐38) [automl] - Automated classification, regression, and clustering workflows built on SmartCore

Libraries / Computation

  • cmccomb/vote (⭐0) [vote] - Common preference aggregation and voting methods

Libraries / Scripting

  • cmccomb/mocktave (⭐3) [mocktave] - Run Octave or MATLAB code from Rust with native and bundled modes

Libraries / Text processing

  • cmccomb/rust-stop-words (⭐26) [stop-words] - Common stop words in many languages

21. Awesome Go

Advanced Console UIs

  • huh (⭐7.2k) - Lightweight library for building interactive forms and prompts in the terminal.

Machine Learning

  • gorse (⭐9.8k) - An offline recommender system backend based on collaborative filtering written in Go.

Testing Frameworks

  • prettycov (⭐3) - Draws a Go coverage profile as a package tree with a total on every row.

DevOps Tools / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares

  • metricsd (⭐1) - Lightweight metrics collector with plugin system, shipping to Prometheus, Splunk HEC, and HTTP JSON endpoints.

22. Awesome Osint

Image Search / GitHub

  • Reverse Image Search Anywhere - Free browser extension and web tool for searching images across Google Lens, Yandex, Bing Visual Search, and TinEye, including images on sites where direct image URLs fail.

Threat Intelligence / GitHub

  • Dread Scraper (⭐1) - Slow, resumable archiver for selected Dread boards, routed through Tor. Saves threads and replies to a local SQLite database with full-text search for offline threat-intelligence research.

23. Awesome Go

CLI & Terminal / Standard CLI

  • jessevdk/go-flags (⭐2.7k) — Command-line option parser ☆2,693

24. Awesome Mac

Communication / Collaboration

  • blendbyte/Textual (⭐1.9k) — Textual is a native IRC client for macOS ☆1,911

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 04, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Django

Projects / Open Source Projects

  • ioe (⭐1.5k) - Self-hosted retail store management with inventory, sales checkout, and member accounts.

2. Awesome Algorand

AI and Machine Learning / Visual Studio

  • Predge - Polymarket whale trades, wallet scores and smart-money signals for AI agents, paid per call over x402 with USDC on Algorand via the GoPlausible facilitator.

3. Awesome Cyber Security University

Introduction and Pre-Security / Level 1 - Intro

  • WebTerm Learn - Free Linux command line courses where each lesson ends in hands-on exercises in a simulated terminal in the browser. A free account is needed after the first lesson.

4. Awesome Cli Apps

Development / Chat

  • herdr-reviewr (⭐823) - Review a coding agent's diff and send line comments back to it.

5. Awesome Flame

App Releases / Arcade

  • Oh Dash! - iOS - Play a fast paced arcade game by dodging various hazards and try to be top player on the world! - By Davi Bispo

App Releases / Casual

  • Dhoruba - iOS - Can You Stand The Rain? By Kevin Omyonga
  • Wormo - iOS - Meet Wormo the gooey worm in this wonderful casual game! Think you can put wormo in the nest? Think again, it requires an extraordinary technique. By Tommy Buonomo (Frenchie Games)
  • Upverse: Endless Jump - Android - Bounce from a sunny meadow into space and beyond. How high can you go? By xeinebiu

App Releases / Sports

  • Cycling Escape - GitHub (⭐11) - You start off with only one rider. Compete in races to start earning money. Unlock more team mates and compete in more extreme and longer races. Keep going and win the ultimate world tour! By ikbendewilliam

6. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • AFFiNE - AFFiNE is an open-source knowledge base that merges docs, whiteboard and databases on one canvas, with local-first storage, real-time collaboration and Docker self-hosting. (Source (⭐73k))
  • AgenticSeek - AgenticSeek is a GPL-3.0 autonomous AI agent that browses, codes and plans on your own machine with local models — a self-described local alternative to Manus. (Source (⭐27k))
  • Amical - Amical is an MIT-licensed, local-first AI dictation app for macOS and Windows, with context-aware formatting, custom vocabulary and an Android app. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • AnythingLLM - AnythingLLM is an MIT-licensed AI workspace for macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker that lets you chat with your own documents and run agents with a local or cloud model. (Source (⭐67k))
  • Baserow - Baserow is an open-core, self-hostable no-code database and app builder whose open-source edition is MIT-licensed, with a hosted cloud at baserow.io. (Source (⭐6.1k))
  • Eigent - Eigent is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that splits work across several AI agents running in parallel, with any model including local ones. (Source (⭐15k))
  • Excalidraw - Excalidraw is an MIT-licensed virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn-style diagrams, with end-to-end encrypted live collaboration, local-first autosave and a React component for embedding. (Source (⭐133k))
  • Flow Launcher - Flow Launcher is an MIT-licensed keyboard launcher for Windows 10 and 11 with fast file search, a preview panel and a large plugin ecosystem. (Source (⭐16k))
  • FluidVoice - FluidVoice is a free, GPL-3.0 macOS dictation app that transcribes on-device with very low latency and optionally cleans up text with a cloud or local model. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Formbricks - Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform — link, website, in-app and email surveys — that you can self-host with Docker or use as a cloud service. (Source (⭐13k))
  • FreeFlow - FreeFlow is an MIT-licensed Mac dictation app that transcribes and cleans up speech with Groq or any OpenAI-compatible provider you configure, with no FreeFlow server in between. (Source (⭐2.8k))
  • Grist - Grist is an Apache-licensed relational spreadsheet that combines spreadsheet formulas with database structure, self-hostable with Docker and available as a desktop app. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Handy - Handy is an MIT-licensed, fully offline dictation app for Windows, macOS and Linux that types what you say into any text field using Whisper or Parakeet on your own machine. (Source (⭐33k))
  • HeyForm - HeyForm is an AGPL-licensed, self-hostable builder for conversational forms, surveys, quizzes and polls, with logic, theming, analytics and integrations. (Source (⭐9k))
  • It's a Plan - It's a Plan is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted project management and issue tracking app where AI agents take issues on the same board as people, with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server. (Source (⭐883))
  • Jan - Jan is an Apache-2.0 desktop app that runs open LLMs offline on your own computer, with optional cloud models, custom assistants, MCP and a local OpenAI-compatible server. (Source (⭐45k))
  • Kanboard - Kanboard is an MIT-licensed Kanban project management app that focuses on simplicity, with WIP limits, automatic actions and a small PHP footprint. (Source (⭐9.9k))
  • Kaneo - Kaneo is an MIT-licensed, self-hostable project management app with boards, lists, calendars and Gantt charts, GitHub and Gitea integration, a REST API and MCP. (Source (⭐9.3k))
  • Khoj - Khoj is an AGPL-3.0 personal AI assistant that searches the web and your own documents with local or online models, self-hosted or on Khoj's cloud app. (Source (⭐38k))
  • Kinetic Life OS - Kinetic Life OS is a GPL-3.0 installable PWA that connects projects, everyday actions, health records, workouts, calendar review, and inspiration in one local-first personal workspace. (Source (⭐1))
  • Leantime - Leantime is an AGPL-3.0, self-hostable project management system that combines strategy, planning and execution, with task views, goals, timesheets and docs in one tool. (Source (⭐12k))
  • Libre WebUI - Libre WebUI is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted AI workspace with local models through Ollama, document chat, artifacts and sandboxed work environments, and no application telemetry. (Source (⭐88))
  • LibreChat - LibreChat is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI chat platform with a ChatGPT-style interface, many model providers, agents, MCP and multi-user authentication, run with Docker Compose. (Source (⭐45k))
  • LimeSurvey - LimeSurvey is a GPL-licensed, self-hostable survey platform with branching logic, multilingual surveys, response statistics, plugins and an API. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • Lotti - Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling, habits and health data, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents. (Source (⭐1.2k))
  • Minutes - Minutes is an MIT-licensed, local-first meeting and voice-memo recorder with on-device transcription, Markdown output, a CLI and an MCP server, for macOS and Windows with a CLI on Linux. (Source (⭐1.5k))
  • Morphic - Morphic is an Apache-2.0 AI search engine with generative UI that self-hosts with Docker Compose, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama or other providers and SearxNG, Tavily, Brave or Exa for search. (Source (⭐9.2k))
  • Open Cowork - Open Cowork is an MIT-licensed desktop agent for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs that works in a folder you choose and isolates its commands in a local VM, with your own API key. (Source (⭐2.2k))
  • OpenLess - OpenLess is an AGPL-3.0 voice-typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android that transcribes speech and rewrites it in a chosen style, using the speech and language providers you configure. (Source (⭐3.7k))
  • OpenMausBot - OpenMausBot is an Apache-2.0 desktop app for macOS, Windows and Ubuntu that turns your local Claude, Codex and Grok CLIs into a roster of AI bots you chat with, each with its own computer. (Source (⭐4k))
  • OpenProject - OpenProject is a GPL-3.0 project management platform for organisations that want a self-hosted alternative to Jira and MS Project, with agile boards, Gantt planning and time tracking. (Source (⭐16k))
  • OpenWhispr - OpenWhispr is an MIT-licensed voice dictation and meeting transcription app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with on-device speech models or bring-your-own-key cloud models. (Source (⭐8.9k))
  • OpenWork - OpenWork is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs AI agents on your own files with the model of your choice. The app is MIT; a separate team control plane is under a commercial licence. (Source (⭐24k))
  • OpenWorker - OpenWorker is an MIT-licensed desktop AI coworker for macOS and Windows that works with your own model key or Ollama and asks before anything consequential. (Source (⭐18k))
  • OpnForm - OpnForm is an open-source form builder you can self-host or use as a managed cloud service, with logic, embeds, integrations, analytics and an MCP server. (Source (⭐3.8k))
  • Plane - Plane is an AGPL-3.0 project management and issue tracking platform, self-hosted as the Community Edition or used on Plane Cloud, and one of the largest open-source Linear and Jira alternatives. (Source (⭐60k))
  • Presenton - Presenton is an Apache-2.0 AI presentation generator for the web, Docker and desktop that exports editable PowerPoint files and works with local or cloud models. (Source (⭐11k))
  • Rakazo - Rakazo is an Apache-2.0 platform for running always-on AI bots with their own computers, self-hosted with Docker Compose and used from web, desktop or mobile. (Source (⭐3.3k))
  • Rome - Rome is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted environment where an AI agent turns repeated work into saved actions and installable apps, run with one Docker script. (Source (⭐689))

entry.content:
1. Free for Dev

Testing

  • stateofpixel - Catch UI regressions before they merge. Your CI takes the screenshots with Playwright, Storybook or any tool that writes PNGs, and a person approves each change on the pull request. Open source and self-hostable. Free up to 10 GB.

Crash and Exception Handling

  • Everframe - Everframe is bug tracking, crash collection tool with AI triage, reporter conversations and boards all in one platform - for mobile, web, TV and Roku apps. Free tier includes 1000 monthly active installs with unlimited bug and crash reports, unlimited apps and seats, every SDK and AI triage on 50 reports per month.

Email

  • DomainCanary - DMARC enforcement service that protects your domain from email spoofing. First domain is free with 90 days of report detail and step-by-step policies you publish yourself.
  • Pharos - Transactional email API and SMTP relay service for developers. 3,000 emails a month free.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Cabin - Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics with per-page carbon estimates and an MCP server for AI assistants. Free plan: 1 site, 10k pageviews/month.

Other Free Resources

  • VPS Snaps - Automated server backups and snapshots across 8 cloud providers, stored in your own bucket or Google Drive. Free plan: 1 server, daily backups, no credit card.

2. Awesome Computational Biology

General Biomedical Agents

  • Biomni (⭐3.9k) — General-purpose biomedical AI agent integrating planning, code execution, specialized tools, databases, and software across diverse biomedical research tasks.
  • ToolUniverse (⭐1.7k) — Unified scientific tool ecosystem for building AI scientists that can discover, select, and execute biomedical tools and databases.
  • BioMedAgent (⭐143) — Self-evolving multi-agent framework for autonomous biomedical data analysis with tool discovery, workflow planning, code generation, execution, correction, and cross-omics analysis.
  • BioMaster (⭐114) — Multi-agent system for automated and auditable bioinformatics workflows spanning RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, single-cell, spatial omics, Hi-C, long reads, metagenomics, and proteomics.
  • BRAD (⭐64) — Retrieval-augmented bioinformatics assistant integrating scientific literature, databases, external tools, and executable workflows.

Therapeutics & Drug Discovery Agents

  • TxAgent (⭐655) — Therapeutic reasoning agent using multi-step reasoning and a large scientific tool universe for drug interactions, contraindications, and personalized treatment analysis.
  • Medea (⭐131) — Multi-agent therapeutic discovery system combining research planning, biological data analysis, literature reasoning, and multi-LLM deliberation across single-cell, cell-line, and patient contexts.
  • DrugAgent (⭐1) — Multi-agent biomedical evidence synthesis framework for computational drug discovery with reliability-aware aggregation.

Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

  • STELLA (⭐156) — Self-evolving biomedical research agent that expands its tool repertoire and supports literature reasoning, computational analysis, and laboratory-oriented scientific workflows.
  • AutoBA (⭐239) — Automated multi-omics analysis agent that plans, executes, and repairs bioinformatics workflows from natural-language objectives.
  • GenoMAS (⭐135) — Multi-agent framework for code-driven gene-expression analysis with planning, execution, debugging, backtracking, and GEO/TCGA-based scientific discovery.
  • BIA (⭐45) — Bioinformatics agent for GEO search, sample metadata extraction, count-matrix processing, and pipeline extraction from papers.
  • BioAgents (⭐47) — Multi-agent bioinformatics assistant using specialized language models and retrieval for genomics workflow development and troubleshooting.
  • Genomi (⭐483) — Local-first genomics agent runtime that indexes personal variants, queries evidence, and generates evidence-grounded reports while keeping raw genome data on-device.

Multi-Agent Scientific Labs

  • Virtual Lab (⭐737) — Human–AI collaborative research environment in which an LLM principal investigator coordinates specialized scientist agents for scientific discovery.
  • Agent Laboratory (⭐5.9k) — End-to-end multi-agent research workflow for literature review, experimentation, implementation, analysis, and report generation.

Paper & Workflow Agents

  • Paper2Agent (⭐3.6k) — Multi-agent system that transforms research papers and associated code into interactive, testable scientific agents and MCP tools.

Cancer Genome Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • TESSERA (⭐6) — Cancer-genome foundation model jointly pretrained on somatic SNVs and copy-number alterations from TCGA using masked reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning.

Single-Cell Epigenomics Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • EpiAgent (⭐72) — scATAC-seq foundation model pretrained on ~5M cells and >35B tokens for representation learning, annotation, imputation, perturbation prediction, and in-silico cCRE knockout.
  • SCARF — Single-cell RNA+ATAC foundation model pretrained on >2.7M cells for multimodal representation, matching, cross-omics translation, and few-shot annotation.
  • scDNAm-GPT (⭐20) — Foundation model for single-cell whole-genome bisulfite sequencing with whole-genome context modeling at single-CpG resolution.
  • EpiFoundation — Foundation model for scATAC-seq using peak-to-gene aligned pretraining for cell representation, annotation, batch correction, and gene-expression prediction.
  • ChromFound (⭐6) — Genome-aware scATAC-seq foundation model pretrained on 1.97M cells across tissues and disease contexts for zero-shot cell representations, annotation, and cross-omics prediction.
  • Atacformer — Transformer foundation model for scATAC-seq that learns embeddings of cis-regulatory elements for clustering, annotation, and reference mapping.
  • CLM-X — Multi-way Transformer foundation model jointly handling RNA-only, ATAC-only, and paired RNA–ATAC single-cell inputs for integration, translation, annotation, and perturbation prediction.

Other Omics Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • CAPTAIN — Multimodal foundation model pretrained on co-assayed single-cell RNA and protein for joint representation learning and cross-modal downstream tasks.
  • HiCFoundation — Hi-C foundation model pretrained on large-scale chromatin-contact maps for 3D-genome analysis, epigenomic prediction, and single-cell Hi-C adaptation.
  • OmicsFM (⭐6) — Modality-agnostic molecular-expression foundation model with matched proteomics, bulk-transcriptomics, and single-cell-transcriptomics checkpoints.
  • VirTues (⭐156) — Spatial-proteomics foundation model learning marker-aware representations across proteins, cells, niches, and tissues from multiplexed imaging.

5. Awesome Computational Biology

Drug Response & Perturbation

  • Chem-PerturBridge (⭐2) — Harmonized compendium and processing pipelines for small-molecule perturbation transcriptomics across heterogeneous assays and gene panels.
  • GSE191127 Breast Cancer Pre/Post Chemotherapy — Bulk RNA-seq and genomics from matched pre- and post-neoadjuvant chemotherapy breast tumors with treatment outcomes.
  • LINCS L1000 Phase 1 (⭐2) — Phase-1 L1000 benchmark view used by Bison with 692,787 profiles, 9,233 molecules, 70 contexts, and 978 landmark genes.
  • LINCS L1000 Phase 2 (⭐2) — Phase-2 L1000 benchmark view used by Bison with 333,263 profiles, 1,760 molecules, 30 contexts, and 978 landmark genes.
  • MIX-Seq — Multiplexed single-cell transcriptional profiling of chemical and genetic perturbation responses across pools of cancer cell lines.
  • Novartis Perturbation Dataset (⭐2) — Large chemical perturbation transcriptomic screen used in Chem-PerturBridge; the Bison benchmark view contains 46,748 profiles and 3,770 molecules.
  • OP3 (⭐2) — Chemical perturbation dataset used by Chem-PerturBridge and the Bison unseen-compound benchmark; the Bison benchmark view contains 1,813 profiles, 138 molecules, and 4 cellular contexts.
  • PDX-Atlas — Portal integrating clinical, genomic, transcriptomic, and drug-response data from patient-derived xenograft models.
  • sci-Plex — Single-cell chemical perturbation screen of ~650,000 transcriptomes across three cancer cell lines, 188 compounds, and four doses.
  • Tahoe-100M — Giga-scale single-cell perturbation atlas with >100 million profiles from 50 cancer cell lines exposed to ~1,100 small molecules.
  • VCPI-0001 (⭐2) — Bulk chemical perturbation dataset used in Chem-PerturBridge; the Bison benchmark view contains 27,517 profiles and 2,272 molecules in one cellular context.
  • VCPI-0002 (⭐2) — Bulk chemical perturbation dataset used in Chem-PerturBridge; the Bison benchmark view contains 18,139 profiles and 1,488 molecules in one cellular context.

Genetic Perturbation & Perturb-seq

  • Dixit et al. 2016 Perturb-seq — Pooled CRISPR knockout with single-cell RNA-seq across K562 and dendritic-cell screens, including stimulated conditions and combinatorial perturbations.
  • Adamson et al. 2016 Perturb-seq — CRISPRi Perturb-seq in K562 cells for systematic dissection of the unfolded protein response.
  • Datlinger et al. 2017 CROP-seq — Pooled CRISPR knockout screen with single-cell transcriptomic readout in Jurkat cells under T-cell receptor stimulation.
  • Norman et al. 2019 CRISPRa Perturb-seq — Large-scale CRISPR activation Perturb-seq in K562 cells spanning single-gene and combinatorial perturbations.
  • Gasperini et al. 2019 CRISPRi enhancer screen — High-MOI single-cell CRISPRi screen in K562 cells targeting thousands of candidate enhancers to map enhancer-gene regulation.
  • Replogle et al. 2022 K562 Genome-wide Perturb-seq — Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq targeting nearly all expressed genes in K562 cells.
  • Replogle et al. 2022 K562 Essential Perturb-seq — CRISPRi Perturb-seq focused on essential genes in K562 cells.
  • Replogle et al. 2022 RPE1 Essential Perturb-seq — CRISPRi Perturb-seq focused on essential genes in RPE1 cells.
  • Frangieh et al. 2021 Perturb-CITE-seq — Multimodal CRISPR knockout screen with RNA and surface-protein readouts in patient-derived melanoma models under immune-related conditions.

Drug Response Prediction

  • PASO (⭐8) — Pathway-aware multi-omics drug response model combining pathway-difference features, multi-scale convolutions, Transformer encoding, and drug SMILES.
  • DTLCDR — Target-based multimodal framework for preclinical cancer drug response prediction and transfer to clinical response, with explicit unseen-drug generalization.
  • THERAPI (⭐1) — Cell-line-to-patient transfer framework that aligns tumor transcriptomes with cancer cell lines and integrates perturbation and gene-level representations for patient drug response prediction.
  • EXPRESSO — Supervised treatment-response framework using pretreatment tumor transcriptomics, drug targets, and context-specific biomarkers across multiple cancer types and therapies.
  • PerturbRx — Treatment-conditioned representation learning framework that transfers drug-induced latent transitions learned from single-cell perturbation data to patient-level cancer treatment-response prediction.

Drug Perturbation

  • Bison — Cross-dataset model for globally unseen-compound response prediction using a shared gene representation, discrete diffusion models, and matched drug-contrast supervision.
  • biolord (⭐102) — Deep generative model that disentangles known and unknown attributes for conditional generation of single-cell states.
  • PerturbNet (⭐69) — Conditional generative model for predicting distributions of single-cell states under unseen chemical and genetic perturbations.
  • CellFlow (⭐160) — Conditional flow-matching framework for modeling and predicting cellular phenotypes under chemical, genetic, and other perturbations.
  • Prophet (⭐41) — Transformer model for predicting cellular phenotypes under unseen chemical or genetic perturbations across heterogeneous assays and contexts.
  • PrePR-CT (⭐8) — Graph-based model using cell-type-specific co-expression networks as inductive priors for small-data chemical perturbation response prediction.
  • XPert (⭐27) — Knowledge-informed dual-branch Transformer for drug-induced transcriptional perturbation prediction across dose, time, and cellular context.
  • State (⭐707) — Transition model for predicting cellular perturbation responses across diverse contexts and sets of cells.
  • TxPert (⭐52) — Knowledge-graph-informed latent-transfer model for transcriptomic perturbation prediction across unseen single perturbations, combinations, and cross-context settings.
  • LPM (⭐54) — Large perturbation model that jointly learns heterogeneous perturbation experiments by disentangling perturbation, readout, and context representations.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

  • CellFM (⭐115) — 800M-parameter single-cell foundation model pretrained on transcriptomics from 100 million human cells for annotation, integration, gene-function, and perturbation tasks.
  • scPRINT-2 (⭐39) — Next-generation single-cell foundation model pretrained on 350M+ cells across 22K+ datasets and 16 species for embeddings, denoising, annotation, gene-network inference, and cross-species transfer.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Pathology Foundation Models

  • TITAN (⭐371) — Multimodal whole-slide pathology foundation model that combines image and language supervision for slide-level representation and zero-shot analysis.
